# ☀️ Your Morning News Digest

Good morning! Grab your coffee and let's catch up on what's making headlines today. Here are the stories worth knowing about.

---

**🚀 Setback for Blue Origin in the Space Race**
Jeff Bezos's New Glenn rocket was destroyed in a major explosion, dealing a blow to Blue Origin's space ambitions. The setback raises questions about NASA's plans to return to the moon and means the U.S. may lean even more heavily on Elon Musk's SpaceX as it competes with China.

**✈️ Southwest Brings Back Free Extra Seats**
Good news for travelers who need a little more room. Southwest Airlines is reversing course and will once again offer plus-size passengers a second seat for free, instead of asking them to pay for it.

**📈 Falling Oil Prices Push Stocks to New Highs**
Markets hit fresh records as oil prices took a dive, with Brent crude dropping 19% in May—its steepest monthly fall since 2020. Lower energy costs are helping lift investor spirits across the board.

**🌍 SEC Wants to Drop Climate Reporting Rule**
The Securities and Exchange Commission is proposing to repeal a rule that required some companies to disclose their greenhouse gas emissions and climate-related risks. It's the latest move to roll back environmental regulations introduced during the Biden administration.

**💼 Meta Cuts Over 2,000 Jobs at Headquarters**
Facebook's parent company, Meta, laid off more than 2,000 workers at its Menlo Park headquarters in California. The cuts are part of a larger round of layoffs the tech giant has been making throughout the year.

**🎵 Universal Music Turns Down Billionaire's Offer**
Universal Music Group rejected a takeover bid from billionaire investor Bill Ackman and his firm, Pershing Square. The company said the offer "fundamentally undervalued" its business.

**💸 Company Burns Through $500M on AI in One Month**
A cautionary tale for the AI era: an unnamed company reportedly spent a staggering $500 million on Claude AI in a single month. The culprit? Unlimited employee access and a lack of spending controls—a reminder that even powerful tools need some guardrails.

---

That's the latest for now—stay informed and have a wonderful day! 🌤️

# ☀️ Your Morning News Digest

Good morning! Grab your coffee and let's catch up on what's making headlines today. Here's a quick rundown of the stories everyone's talking about.

---

**🎬 Marcia Lucas, Star Wars Editor, Passes Away at 80**
Marcia Lucas, the Oscar-winning editor behind the original *Star Wars* and former wife of George Lucas, has died at age 80. Her editing work helped shape one of the most beloved films of all time. She'll be remembered as a true behind-the-scenes legend.

**🎵 Music Mogul Clive Davis Hospitalized**
Clive Davis, the legendary producer who helped launch the careers of Whitney Houston, Aretha Franklin, and Kelly Clarkson, has been hospitalized in New York. Details are still limited, but fans are sending their well-wishes. We're hoping for good news soon.

**🍿 'Backrooms' Set for a Huge Box Office Debut**
The new horror film *Backrooms* is off to a roaring start, with $10 million already from preview screenings. Industry experts predict it could pull in $76–79 million during its opening weekend. That's a big win for fans of scary movies!

**🎤 State Fair Concert Series Loses Half Its Lineup**
More than half of the performers scheduled for the Great American State Fair concerts have backed out, citing politics and even threats. Bret Michaels and Martina McBride are the latest big names to drop out. Organizers are now scrambling as the summer event approaches.

**💬 Erika Kirk Shuts Down Boyfriend Rumors**
Erika Kirk is firing back at reports claiming she has a new boyfriend less than a year after her husband Charlie Kirk's death. She's calling the rumor a "deranged lie" and isn't holding back. Sometimes you just have to set the record straight.

**📺 Apple TV's New Sci-Fi Show Earns Early Praise**
Apple TV just dropped *Star City*, a fresh sci-fi series that critics are already loving. Even better, it's the first of several planned spinoffs connected to Apple's existing shows. Looks like sci-fi fans have a lot to look forward to.

**🍽️ Four DC Restaurants Make a Top 50 List**
Four restaurants in Washington, D.C. have earned spots on the prestigious "North America's 50 Best Restaurants" list. It's a big moment for the city's growing food scene. If you're in the area, these spots are definitely worth a visit!

---

That's all for now—have a wonderful day, and we'll see you with more updates tomorrow! 👋
